id: ops-01
title: "The alert you would delete"
minutes: 5
tier: core
competencies: [diagnosis]
---

## Ask

Which alert would you delete from a system you inherited, and how would you decide?

## Look for

### engineer

- Names a signal that never led to action
- Says what they would check before deleting it

## Follow-ups

- What would you put in its place?
- Who would you tell?
